name: Messages Icon
description: Messages/chat icon with multiple animation variations for different messaging states

variations.name: typing
variations.description: Front bubble bounces gently up and down to indicate someone is typing. Perfect for real-time chat applications.

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height of the icon in pixels

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the SVG element

props.name: isTyping
props.description: Controls the typing bounce animation. Set to true when someone is typing.

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration of one typing bounce in seconds

props.name: ease
props.description: Easing of the animation. Accepts a named ease or a cubic-bezier array.

variations.name: wiggle
variations.description: Entire icon rotates gently (±5°) on hover. Great for unread message indicators or clickable chat buttons.

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height of the icon in pixels

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the SVG element

props.name: isHovered
props.description: Controls the wiggle animation. Manage this state in the parent via onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave.

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration of the wiggle in seconds

props.name: ease
props.description: Easing of the animation. Accepts a named ease or a cubic-bezier array.

variations.name: slideIn
variations.description: Bubbles slide in from opposite sides with spring bounce. Perfect for chat interface loading or conversation opening.

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height of the icon in pixels

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the SVG element

props.name: isVisible
props.description: Controls the slide-in animation. Set to true to show icon with animation, false to hide.

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration of each bubble slide in seconds; the second bubble's delay scales with it

props.name: ease
props.description: Easing of the bubble slide. Accepts a named ease or a cubic-bezier array.
